Subject: Recap: unit-econ check + a couple of asks

Hi Emma — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and suggested next steps so we’re aligned on the numbers before we build a pilot proposal.

TL;DR: we sketched a few $/1M-token scenarios on the call. To finalize pricing we need your confirmed volume bands and the feature surface you want in month 1 vs month 6.

Key notes from the call:
- Product scope (you said):
  - Summarization (4–6 sentences), user-initiated (avg 600 tokens inbound, 80 tokens outbound).
  - In-app search embeddings (upsert + query), ~100 tokens per query.
  - Conversational assistance (chat snippets), avg 350 tokens per interaction.
- Expected active users: 12k MAU, beta cohort ~2k (month 1).
- Estimated query rate (your estimate): 1–1.5M tokens/day at peak, ~20–30M tokens/month after month 3.

What we need from you to lock down a target $/1M:
1) Confirm a realistic monthly token band (low/expected/high). Example: 5M / 20M / 40M.
2) Confirm which features ship in month 1 (we’ll price per-feature marginal cost + model choice).
3) Budget cadence: is this part of a fixed monthly procurement budget or a usage billing model? Any target $/month you’re comfortable with?

Attached: initial unit-econ workbook (healthsync-unit-econ-v1.xlsx) — we filled in two model profiles and rough $/1M numbers for discussion.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm the three asks above by EOW (May 7).
- We turn around a 3-month pilot price (including a token credit and performance SLOs).
- If budget looks good, propose a PO/term-sheet and a pilot kickoff.

Thanks — I’ll loop Karthik and Aditya for the CAC/payback and infra assumptions.

—

Emma — I pulled the numbers into the workbook and added a conservative and a performance model line. Attached: healthsync-unit-econ-v1.xlsx (updated v2 in drive).

Assumptions (short):
- Summarization: avg 680 tokens in / 80 out => 760 tokens per request.
- Embeddings: 1 upsert (200 tokens) per new doc + 3 queries/day @ 100 tokens = 500 tokens/user/month (for active users doing search).
- Conversational (not in M1): avg 350 tokens/interaction.
- Model profiles: smaller LLM quantized (cost baseline) vs mid-size non-quantized (perf).

Back-of-envelope $/1M tokens (examples):
- Quantized small model path: $180 / 1M tokens
- Mid-size non-quantized high-perf path: $520 / 1M tokens

Per-feature incremental cost (monthly) using the expected band (24M/month), rough numbers:
- Summarization: 24M * (760 / 1,000,000) = ~18,240 requests equivalent -> at $180/1M => ~$3,283/month (quantized) or ~$9,469/month (mid-size).
- Embeddings (search): assuming 50% of MAU active = 6k active => 6k * 500 tokens = 3M tokens => at $180/1M => ~$540/month (quantized) or ~$1,560/month (mid-size).
- Combined M1 inference cost (quantized path, expected band): ~ $3.8k/month; mid-size path: ~ $11k/month.

Notes on SLO/latency: quantized small models typically give p95 under 250ms for short summaries at our Dedicated profiles; mid-size can be 300–500ms depending on sequence length.

Emma / Marissa — quick note on CAC payback and margin targets so HealthSync can plug into your finance model.

Simple CAC-payback framework (one-line):
- Payback months = CAC per new customer / (ARPU_monthly * gross_margin_after_inference)
Where gross_margin_after_inference = (1 - inference_cost_per_user / ARPU_monthly) * gross_margin_before_inference.

Example we can share (plugging roughs):
- Assume ARPU on the feature = $12/month (conservative).
- Inference cost per active user (quantized path) = 500 tokens/user/month (search) + 200 tokens/user/month (occasional summarize) => ~700 tokens/user => at $180/1M => $0.126 / user / month.
- If your gross margin before inference is 70%, then after inference it becomes ~69.8% (tiny change at this scale).
- CAC of $45 => payback = 45 / (12 * 0.698) ≈ 5.4 months.

Margin and pricing guidance for negotiations: aim for >60% gross margin after inference across launch pricing. That gives room for sales/CS to pursue expansion while keeping unit economics healthy.

Commercial ask I’m comfortable approving for the pilot: 25% token credit (up to 1M tokens) + a reduced onboarding fee. If you want the full 100% credit we should ask for a short case-study clause and a 6-month usage commitment.

If HealthSync is OK with the 25% credit + PO for onboarding, I’ll prepare the pricing rows and the pilot term-sheet for signature.

—Karthik
